desc: The compact, yet rough-looking, Rowdy is a new type of Bond Arm gun. It's built with a 3? barrel chambered for 45/410. Works best with smoothed lined holsters. Features: Stainless steel double-barrel and frame. Compatible with all standard Bond Arms barrels. Automatic spent casing extractor. Patented rebounding hammer. Retracting firing pins. Cross-bolt safety. Spring-loaded, cammed locking lever.
